27,818 km2 (ratio 0.968); 25 km2 more than 1991-1999, which is outline detail: the Albania page records no frontier change in 2000.

ledger.note: 1991-04-29: the Republic of Albania is proclaimed. The infobox gives '4th Republic of Albania: 29 April 1991' and the page says 'After the first multi-party elections of 1991'; the current constitution is dated 28 November 1998.

region.text: 'the entire south of the country was out of government control' (Vlore, Saranda, Gjirokaster, Berat and other towns)

ledger.note: 1997-03: the south of Albania slips out of government control. 'The government lost control of Vlore, Saranda, Gjirokaster and other southern towns'; 'With the fall of Gjirokaster, the entire south of the country was out of government control' (7 March); Berat fell on 10 March and Pogradec in April. No state took the land: it was held by Salvation Committees and 'armed gangs'. The three counties are my reading of the towns named.
1997-04-03: Special Forces retake Berat. 'The police made gains in restoring order in Tirana, while Special Forces took control of Berat' (3 April); the county is my reading of the town.

region.text: Vlore, Saranda, Gjirokaster and the other southern towns, restored to government control

ledger.note: 1997-08: government control of the far south is largely restored. The page gives no date for Vlore, Saranda or Gjirokaster; it says Operation Alba deployed from 15 April, elections were held on 29 June 1997 and the force left on 11 August, and that 'By mid-August 1997, it had largely restored public order'. The date is a bridge, not a page date.

wars.name: 1997 Albanian rebellion
belligerents: Committees of Public Salvation and armed gangs of southern Albania
wars.outcome: No border change: the south was out of government control from March 1997, Operation Alba deployed from 15 April, early parliamentary elections were held on 29 June 1997 (second round 6 July) and the force left on 11 August.
wars.note: Open rebellion 'effectively began' on 24 January 1997; the Committee of Public Salvation was formed in Vlora on 4 March under Albert Shyti.

certainty.note: The frontiers date from the Treaty of London of 29 July 1913, which 'delineated the borders of the country and its neighbors' (Albania page); the page read gives no border change after 1991.

notes: Wikidata Q467864 is shared with people-s-socialist-republic-of-albania; the other eu-22 part wrote that as a separate dossier (it ends 29 April 1991 and names this slug as successor), and this one follows: the land is identical cell for cell, the family is balkans, and the orchestrator may merge the two colours. The 1997 loss and gain use counterpart nobody because no state or rebel state held the south (committees and gangs); the restoration date is a confidence-1 bridge. Not settled: the History of Albania page loaded only to 1941 (recorded in sources), so the 1990 collapse, the December 1990 legalisation of opposition and the March 1991 elections are undated here; the Albania page is silent on the Montenegro, North Macedonia and Greece frontiers after 1991.
